currency.label: Store Currency
currency.help: The three-letter code every price and order is in, such as USD, EUR or GBP. Choose it before the first order: changing it later does not convert existing prices or orders.

storeName.label: Store Name
storeName.help: The name receipts come from: it is their sender name, and it is in their subject and text. Leave empty to use the site name.

storeEmail.label: Store Email
storeEmail.help: Where a buyer's reply to a receipt goes. The receipt also shows it as the address to write to. Leave empty and replies go to the address your site sends email from.

customerCollection.label: Customer Accounts Collection
customerCollection.help: The auth collection customers sign in to, so they can see their orders. Leave empty for guest checkout only.

providers.label: Payment Providers
providers.help: The ways a buyer can pay. Checkout lists them in the order shown here. A provider appears here once its extension is enabled, and is offered to buyers once it has its keys.

checkoutMode.label: Checkout
checkoutMode.help: Where the buyer pays. Provider's page sends them to the payment provider and brings them back. On this site shows the payment form on your own page; it is used when the chosen provider can do it, and the provider's page otherwise.

orderNumberStart.label: First Order Number
orderNumberStart.help: The number the first order gets. Raise it later to jump ahead; lowering it does nothing, because a number is never used twice.

orderNumberPrefix.label: Order Number Prefix
orderNumberPrefix.help: Shown before an order number, as in #1001. For display only.

taxMode.label: Tax
taxMode.help: No tax charges none. Added to prices adds it at checkout. Included in prices treats your prices as already including it and shows the tax part on the order.

taxShipping.label: Tax Shipping
taxShipping.help: Charge tax on the shipping amount as well as on the goods.

taxRates.label: Tax Rates
taxRates.help: One row for each place you charge tax. The most specific row wins: a region's rate over its country's, a country's over a row with no country.

shippingMode.label: Shipping
shippingMode.help: No shipping charges none. Flat rate charges one amount for every order. By zone charges by where the order ships.

shippingFlatRate.label: Flat Rate
shippingFlatRate.help: The shipping charge for every order, in the store's currency, such as 4.95.

shippingFreeOver.label: Free Shipping Over
shippingFreeOver.help: Orders at or over this amount ship free. Leave empty for never.

shippingZones.label: Shipping Zones
shippingZones.help: One row for each zone. An order ships at the rate of the first zone that covers its address.

receiptMailer.label: Receipt Email
receiptMailer.help: The mailer template sent when an order is paid, and for each renewal of a subscription.

paymentFailedMailer.label: Failed Payment Email
paymentFailedMailer.help: The mailer template sent once when a subscription's renewal payment fails.

returnPage.label: Order Page
returnPage.help: The Site Builder page that shows an order after payment. Leave empty to use the built-in page.

payPage.label: Payment Page
payPage.help: The Site Builder page that holds the payment form when checkout is on this site. Leave empty to use the built-in page.

downloadTtlHours.label: Download Link Lifetime (hours)
downloadTtlHours.help: How long a link to a purchased file works after the order is paid.

downloadMaxCount.label: Downloads per Purchase
downloadMaxCount.help: How many times one purchased file can be downloaded.

pendingOrderTtlHours.label: Abandoned Checkout Lifetime (hours)
pendingOrderTtlHours.help: An order that was started and never paid is cancelled after this long.

cartMaxLines.label: Most Lines in a Cart
cartMaxLines.help: The most different items one cart can hold.

cartMaxQty.label: Most of One Item
cartMaxQty.help: The highest quantity of one item in a cart.

checkoutAttributes.label: Checkout Attributes
checkoutAttributes.help: Extra values checkout may take from the buyer, by name, such as giftNote. Anything not named here is dropped.

grantableGroups.label: Groups a Product May Grant
grantableGroups.help: A product can give its buyer an access group: a membership. Only the groups chosen here can be given, and the admin group never can. Leave empty and no product grants anything.

purchaseUrl.label: Add Commerce Link
purchaseUrl.help: Where a Pro site without the Commerce add-on is sent to add it.
